verdict: No paid activity this period; organic visibility is declining sharply.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, no paid ads ran on any channel, so leads from paid sources were zero. Your Google Business Profile was the only active channel, generating 51 total actions — but that activity dropped 54% in the most recent week and has gone quiet in the last three days. Search clicks followed the same pattern, falling 53% week-over-week, which confirms a broad pullback in local search visibility rather than an isolated issue. Website sessions held steady at 182 visitors this period, meaning some traffic is still arriving through other paths. Restoring paid activity is the immediate priority to rebuild lead flow while the local search signal recovers.
